title: Bitcoin Keeps Knocking On This Level. Here’s What Happens If It Breaks.
speaker: Drew Dosik

macro_themes.view: Several crypto charts sitting on support and on the verge of breaking down to discounted prices.

calls.condition: Above 80,524 BTC is okay; a break below likely heads to ~75,000. Needs to consolidate above 86,000 to turn bullish.
calls.reason: Repeated tests of horizontal support plus a broken inclining trend line make a near-term breakdown likely.
calls.quote: all of which points towards we could be breaking this level in the near term.

calls.condition: If BTC gets back to 86k, ETH can reach 3,041; a break of the 2,332 trend line targets 2,138.
calls.reason: Uptrend line from June still holding; 3,041 pivot is the near-term cap.
calls.quote: We likely are coming down to this next shelf here at 2138. So that could be a steep decline.

calls.condition: Possible head-and-shoulders; break targets 83.88. Needs to reclaim 120 quickly.
calls.reason: Consolidating on top of support with a possible right shoulder forming.
calls.quote: That could put the price down in Solana down here at 8388 um in the near term if this does end up breaking.

calls.reason: Failed weekly bullish consolidation, rejected at broken trend line; making a beeline to 7.3 cents.
calls.quote: it looks like a Dogecoin is already making a bee line straight down there to that level.

calls.reason: Expects chop near minor support then next decline to the 50% fib retrace, meeting a trend line around Nov 24 for a bounce.
calls.quote: we likely could start chopping sideways for a couple days and then the next decline occurs

notes: BNB 50% fib level not stated as a number. DOGE quoted in cents, converted to USD.
